items.prompt: After a function writes a file and later raises ValueError, what is guaranteed about the earlier file write?

options.text: The write is always automatically undone
options.why: Exceptions do not automatically roll back arbitrary external effects.
A transaction/cleanup design must handle external state.

options.text: The file becomes a Python None value
options.why: An exception changes control flow, not the file type.

options.text: All other processes lose access to the file
options.why: No such locking behaviour follows from ValueError.

items.explanation: An exception unwinds Python control flow; it does not reverse an already completed external action. Design validation, transactions and cleanup explicitly.
